## Structure in cybed: terms

▸schema names

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Job roles carry a category and a specialty area (both derived hierarchy, not published edges) and are linked to Task, Knowledge and Skill statements by code. Click any box or edge label to flip between plain English and the technical schema name.

## Counts

| Measure                                                   | Value |
|:----------------------------------------------------------|:------|
| Organizing units (categories, specialty areas, job roles) | 81    |
| Job roles                                                 | 40    |
| Strict elements (Task, Knowledge, Skill statements)       | 1,419 |
| Elements per organizing unit                              | 17.5  |
| Elements per job role                                     | 35.5  |

Table 1

The document states its own size: 5 categories, 12 specialty areas, and 40 job roles. Job-role cards in the source name only Task, Knowledge, and Skill statement codes; the statement text itself lives in separate appendix tables keyed by those codes, which this ingestion joins back to each role.

**Source**

The Saudi Cybersecurity Workforce Framework (SCyWF – 1.5: 2026) PDF, staged with a hash-verified provenance manifest.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0icHJvdmVuYW5jZS1pY29uIiBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjaWNvbi1nZWFyIiAvPjwvc3ZnPg==)

**Ingestion**

`scripts/010-ingest-scywf.R` reconstructs table cells from PDF word coordinates and joins each job role’s Task/Knowledge/Skill codes to their statement text in the appendix tables.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0icHJvdmVuYW5jZS1pY29uIiBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjaWNvbi1saWNlbnNlIiAvPjwvc3ZnPg==)

**License**

The document carries no copyright line or licence notice; its only markings, “TLP: Clear” and “Document Classification: Public,” are disclosure markings rather than licences. NCA granted cybedtools written permission on 2026-09-20 to ingest and redistribute the content on three conditions: NCA cited as issuing body and source, everything taken from the document carried verbatim with no paraphrase or in-house translation, and anything cybedtools derives marked as derived rather than presented as NCA content.

## Caveats

- The hierarchy edges between job role, specialty area, and category are **cybedtools’s own derivation**, not a structure NCA published as edges. They are marked as derived per the terms of NCA’s permission.
- NCA’s grant named an **earlier edition** (SCyWF – 1: 2020) that NCA no longer publishes; the current 1.5: 2026 edition is ingested by owner decision under the same permission.
- The document’s own disclaimer makes its **Arabic version binding** for matters of meaning and interpretation. cybedtools ingests the English version only.
